Adapted rendering code from https://github.com/LerSent001/orb at commit `047c58cc93587c21dac12183fc0fb1e4101c8e1a` (MIT).

The user-selected Siri Wave preset and glass shader are retained. Editor UI, other presets, and particle render passes are omitted. AI Meeting adds live input/playback levels, state handling, bounded rendering, a CSS fallback, and lifecycle cleanup outside this directory. The MIT notice is also emitted as `ORB-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` in both web builds.
